complexity.notes: Each membership test scans (and slices, copying) the current window, so each extension costs O(window) and the whole loop is O(n^2) despite the window endpoints being monotone; a set of window characters or a last-seen-index dict would give O(n). The unconditional guarded decrement is a small tidy-up of the previous conditional check.
complexity.summary: Sliding window that only ever shrinks by one per step and extends the right end, testing membership via substring scan `s[i+length] not in s[i:i+length]`. The early break skips starts that cannot beat the current best.
